moltis

A secure persistent personal agent server in Rust. One binary, sandboxed execution, multi-provider LLMs, voice, memory, Telegram, WhatsApp, Discord, Teams, and MCP tools. Secure by design, runs on your hardware.

Before installing

Confirm your architecture, OS version and upstream requirements. Release filenames identify packages; they do not prove device compatibility. Your OS will ask for installation approval.
